The only thing more dimwitted than the two loser protagonists in Busboys is this entire cinematic trash dump that's trying to pass as a comedy film. The jokes are as limp and shabby as the awful mullet wig that David Spade wears in this dull movie. Go to Full Review Brian Orndorf Blu-ray.com 5d Content collapsed. Lurches from scene to scene, trying to deliver a laugh riot without actually including any jokes. If there’s a worse film than "Busboys" in 2026, I’ll be shocked.
